text: The Rexdale-Casino Woodbine Community Benefits Agreement demonstrates how large-scale infrastructure projects can be harnessed to deliver meaningful community benefits to local residents. The Agreement's public-private sector collaboration, workforce development targets, and community partnerships directly align with the guiding principles of Inclusive Economic Development . These guiding principles use City levers to support, alongside community partners, accessible pathways to employment, skills training and entrepreneurship for communities that have not benefitted from economic growth in the past. This report provides a 2025 progress update on the agreement's targets and requirements. The majority of the targets and requirements of the Rexdale-Casino Woodbine Community Benefits Agreement are being met or are on track to being met.
